wikipediaReadEvidence.locator: 1 Chronicles 25 table, lines 185–186: 13th division Shubael; footnote says Shebuel in 25:4, cf 23:16 and 24:20
wikipediaReadEvidence.supportJa: The chapter table names Shubael in the thirteenth division and its footnote cross-references the Shebuel forms in 1 Chronicles 23:16 and 24:20. This is a relevant cross-reference, not independent proof that every spelling denotes the same individual.
